bridge-loans.title: Bridge Loans $500K–$25M | TVT Capital
bridge-loans.description: Event-driven bridge loans from TVT Capital — up to $25M, first or second lien, 3–24 month terms. Sized to a defined event: equity raise, acquisition close, refinance, or exit.

growth-capital.title: Growth Capital $250K–$15M | TVT Capital — Non-Dilutive
growth-capital.description: Cash-flow growth capital from TVT Capital — up to $25M, 2–5 year terms, amortizing or interest-only. Non-dilutive expansion capital sized to free cash flow.

working-capital.title: Working Capital $50K–$2M | TVT Capital
working-capital.description: Revenue-backed working capital from TVT Capital — up to $25M, unsecured options, repaid as a fixed share of revenue. Typically funded in days.

second-lien.title: Second-Lien Loans $2M–$20M | TVT Capital
second-lien.description: Second-lien and senior-stretch facilities from TVT Capital — up to $25M layered behind your existing senior bank facility. No refinance required.

acquisition-financing.title: Acquisition Financing $3M–$25M | TVT Capital — M&A, Roll-Ups, MBOs
acquisition-financing.description: Acquisition financing from TVT Capital — up to $25M for sponsor-backed and independent M&A. QofE-friendly diligence.

recapitalizations.title: Recapitalizations $1M–$20M | TVT Capital — Dividend Recaps & Partner Buyouts
recapitalizations.description: Recapitalization capital from TVT Capital — up to $25M. Dividend recaps, partner buyouts, and special-situation capital for operators with strong fundamentals.
